answer.reason: The verses tell of Heman's appointment as a singer with cymbals and of the sons God gave him for song in the house of the LORD, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was appointed with Asaph and Ethan to sound with cymbals of brass
clauses.quote: the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass

clauses.english: was given fourteen sons and three daughters by God, who served under him in song in the house of the LORD
clauses.quote: God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

doubts: 1CH 25:5 calls Heman the king's seer, a role close to the summary's 'prophet to David', so it is not made a clause.
The fourteen sons and three daughters are already in the disambiguation text, so the second clause may repeat the summary; it is kept for the sons' service in song.
